description: Research Experience (REU), NHERI 2019: Effects of Cyclic Loading on Jacket Foundations of Offshore Wind Turbines in Sandy Soils is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by KATHRYN POPP, Georgia Institute of Technology (gatech.edu). REU experience hosted and mentored by researchers at UT Austin. Participated in a research team to understand the effects of cyclic loading on jacket foundations. Full project is assigned to Ahmed Hussien of the Unviersity of Texas at Austin. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fvjh-an98. Keywords: Natural hazards, offshore wind turbine, pile-soil interactions, soil interactions, cyclic loading, REU. Published 2019-08-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Public Domain Dedication. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
